reason: Both spot the key gap: the draft makes no promise about how the farm will respond the next time crops fail. A's concrete suggestions (credit when boxes fall below a set level, weekly updates) match what Sam can actually commit to and speak to this reader's 'went quiet' grievance, and its ordered fix list frees the words to add them. B spends more effort on a make-good for last year that Sam hasn't offered and suggests cutting real changes, though its 'don't oversell the nets' point is good.
